      WhatsApp is working on the Native Location Status Update feature. This upcoming feature lets users quickly share their location as a Status update.

      Try Messaging Apps

      It speeds up the process by removing the need to use location stickers in the status composer. You will be able to share your location on status updates without selecting a photo or video first to share location.

      Try Messaging Apps

      WhatsApp Working on a Native Location Status Update

      The Meta-owned messaging app is working on a new feature to improve status updates. The Native location status update feature has been discovered on WhatsApp for  Android beta version 2.26.45.8. With this feature, users will be able to share their location as a native status update.

      Get Mobile Apps

      The Meta-owned messaging app is already allowing users to share their location in the status update. But they need to choose a photo or video from their  phone gallery and add a location sticker over that photo or video.

      This means users need to select a photos or videos as a background everythime when they share their location as a status update. The recipient has to tap on the sticker to get more details about the location.

      Advertisements
      Discover more
      Read Daily News
      Read Tech News
      Try News Readers

      But now, the Meta-owned messaging app is finally removing the requirement to select the sticker to share location. Users will be able to use the new feature in the status composer to share location instead of choosing the sticker from the drawing editor.

      Get Mobile Apps

      When users open the bottom sheet in the Update tab, they will see the new option to share their location as a status. After that, they have to tap the option to share their location, and if the app has permission to access it, WhatsApp will show the current position automatically. Now, users will have to confirm sharing their location as a WhatsApp status update.
